About AHD

A small team doing the whole job properly

AHD IT Solutions is a small IT agency based in Joypurhat, Bangladesh. We design and build the digital side of small and mid-size organisations — the software their staff use every day, the website their customers find first, and the design that ties it together.

Most of our clients come to us with a notebook problem: registers, spreadsheets and manual follow-ups eating hours every week. We turn that into a system with clear screens, sensible reports and training at handover, so the team actually uses it.

  • Custom-built solutions — never copied templates
  • You approve the design before we build anything
  • Clear scope and a clear quote before work begins
  • Training and support after launch, not silence

FAQ

Common questions

A standard business website usually takes 1–3 weeks depending on pages and features. A school or shop management system usually takes 4–8 weeks depending on modules. Either way, you get a clear timeline before we start — you approve the plan first, and we update you at every step.

Cost depends on what you need — pages, features and design work. Tell us your requirements through the contact page and we will send a clear, itemised custom quote before any work begins. No hidden charges, ever.

Yes — a Facebook page is rented space, a website is your own. Customers trust a business with its own website far more, Google can find it, and everything about your services stays organised at one permanent address.

That is exactly what custom software means. We study how your organisation works, then build the system around it — like our School Management Software, which was built around real school workflows.

Yes. We provide training for your team, plus support and maintenance options so your website or software keeps running smoothly and stays up to date.
